name: Italian Pasta Salad with Roast Chicken, Fennel, Peppers & Artichokes (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium food storage containers.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and large dice bell peppers. Add to the baking sheet with the fennel.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, large dice, and add to the baking sheet. Drizzle chicken and veggies with oil, then season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g chicken breasts, boneless skinless
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, stirring halfway, until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Set aside.
While the pasta is cooking, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a large bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
½ tsp salt
½ tsp crushed red pepper
½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts and sun-dried tomatoes. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (106 g) jar artichoke hearts, marinated
6 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken and veggies are cool, add to the bowl, along with drained pasta, and stir to combine. Divide pasta salad between containers, cover, and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy cold or at room temperature.
